description: This file defines classes and templates for parsing text, including a generic parser template, a text parser, and a path parser, within the Thunder::Core namespace. It includes methods for tokenizing, reading numbers, key-value pairs, ranges, and path components.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing text streams with customizable terminator and handler, managing parsing states, word and line collection, and pass-through functionality.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text fragments, providing methods to read tokens, numbers, enumerations, key-value pairs, ranges, and to perform text validation and navigation.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing filesystem paths into drive, path, filename, basename, and extension components.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text from a fragment until delimiters are encountered.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of characters or positions.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds specified characters in the text fragment.

methods.name: SkipLine
methods.description: Skips to the end of the current line.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the fragment against a comparison string, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: ReadNumber
methods.description: Reads a numeric value of specified type from the fragment.

methods.name: ReadEnumerate
methods.description: Reads an enumeration value from the fragment.

methods.name: ReadKeyValuePair
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair separated by a specified divider.

methods.name: ReadRange
methods.description: Reads a range of numbers from the fragment.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a path string into components.
